title_zh: 厦门一公司用敌敌畏给数十家餐厅消杀？当地最新通报：查扣企业剩余库存药品
title_en: Xiamen Company Accused of Using Insecticide for Restaurant Pest Control; Local Authorities Seize Stock
summary_zh: 厦门一公司涉嫌用敌敌畏为数十家餐厅进行消杀，当地最新通报称已查扣企业剩余库存药品，事件正在调查中。
summary_en: A company in Xiamen is suspected of using dichlorvos to disinfect dozens of restaurants. Local authorities have seized its remaining stock and are investigating.
